name: Investment Account Party Role
definition: Specifies roles played by a party that are related to an investment account.

OwnershipBeneficiaryRate.name: Ownership Beneficiary Rate
OwnershipBeneficiaryRate.definition: Percentage of ownership or of beneficial ownership of the shares/units in the account. All subsequent subscriptions and or redemptions will be allocated using the same percentage.

FATCAFormType.name: FATCA Form Type
FATCAFormType.definition: Type of Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) form submitted by the investor.

InvestmentAccount.name: Investment Account
InvestmentAccount.definition: Specifies the account for which the party plays a role. It is derived from the association between AccountPartyRole and Account.

FATCAStatus.name: FATCA Status
FATCAStatus.definition: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) status of the investor.

CRSStatus.name: CRS Status
CRSStatus.definition: Common Reporting Standard (CRS) status of the investor.
